hits.s: o 75.5° inc according to wellplan at 3440 mMD while in CruiseControl. Drilled to TD at 3532 mMD. Recorded TD survey. Circulated 2.5x BU. Retagged TD: no fill. Pumped out of hole with 400 lpm and 19 bar. Observed minor to moderate overpull of to 10 tonne at the following depths: 3509, 3449, 3439, 3220, 3146, and 3110 mMD. These intervals were then wiped and it was possible to pass them with reduced or no overpull. Wel
